title: [main] Bug 650733 External Doc No. now mandatory on Service Invoice
summary: Fixes a bug where posting a service invoice wrongly required an External Document No. The check in Serv-Posting Journals Mgt. is adjusted in the W1, NA and ES layers, and the service invoice posting tests are extended.
key_points: Addresses the bug where External Doc. No. had become mandatory on service invoices
Serv-Posting Journals Mgt. changed in the W1, NA and ES layers
Service invoice posting tests extended in W1 and NA
quote: External Doc No. now mandatory on Service Invoice
